description: Combines public participation strategic foresight adaptive policy and democratic contestability.
Builds strong signal detection preparedness and response triggers for emerging risks.
Links foresight to prevention budgets lifecycle costing resilience investment and implementation capacity.
Uses monitoring review triggers risk tiers audits and revision authority for emerging technologies.
Builds scanning and scenario capacity but may remain weakly connected to budgets and delivery.
Uses pilots prototypes sandboxes and evaluation to learn before large scale implementation.
Builds threat detection and rapid authority but risks surveillance rights erosion and legitimacy failure.
Responds after disruption becomes visible and underinvests in prevention and adaptive authority.
